whatIs.title: What is Laser Hair Removal?
whatIs.p1: Laser hair removal is an aesthetic treatment that helps progressively reduce hair growth using specialized technology that acts directly on the hair follicle.
whatIs.p2: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center we work with personalized protocols for different areas and skin types, providing a more comfortable, safe and effective experience in Turrialba.

forWhom.title: Who is it ideal for?
items: You want to save time in your routine
You want smoother, more uniform skin

benefits.title: What problems does laser hair removal help improve?

items.d: Reduces frequent friction and continuous damage to the skin.
Many people notice a progressive improvement in the appearance of the skin.
Can visually help improve skin uniformity.

benefits.note: 📍 Sessions and results may vary by person.

steps.d: We analyze your skin type, area and needs.
The session usually lasts between 15 and 60 minutes depending on the area.
You receive indications to improve results and protect your skin.

extra.painDesc: The sensation is usually described as small “heat touches” or “light pinpricks”. It is a fast and tolerable treatment.
extra.sessionsTitle: How many sessions do I need?
extra.sessionsDesc: It depends on the hair type and area, but many people start to notice progressive changes from the first sessions.
